description: Use this when the user asks whether DKIM is set up for a domain or a DKIM key is valid. With a selector checks that key; without, tries 40+ common selectors (Google, Microsoft 365, Mailchimp…). Returns key type and length, test mode and revoked keys. Read-only, powered by Lanetti Tools.

domain.description: Public FQDN, e.g. example.com or example.fi. Localhost, private and metadata addresses are rejected.

selector.description: DKIM selector (s= in a DKIM-Signature). Optional: common selectors are tried.

name: oma_check_dkim
title: Check DKIM
